description: Canonical JSON vectors: RFC 8785 serialization of number-free JSON (objects, arrays, strings, booleans, null), and hash = keccak256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

cases.name: key-order
cases.description: Members are sorted by key at every level.

cases.name: utf16-key-order
cases.description: Keys compare as UTF-16 code units: U+1F600 (surrogates D83D DE00) sorts before U+FB01, although its code point is larger.

cases.name: string-escapes
cases.description: Quote, backslash and control characters are escaped; U+007F is not.

value.s:
quote" backslash\ newline
 tab	 control delete

cases.name: unicode-literal
cases.description: Non-ASCII characters are written literally as UTF-8.

cases.name: arrays-keep-order
cases.description: Array order is preserved; empty containers are kept.

cases.name: integers-as-strings
cases.description: Integers are decimal strings, so no precision is lost.
